description: This file defines a Moose role for a Catalyst plugin that sets the HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header in web responses. It hooks into the 'prepare_action' phase to conditionally add the HSTS header based on configuration and request scheme.

classes.name: Coocook::Plugin::StrictTransportSecurity
classes.description: Moose role implementing a Catalyst plugin to set HTTP Strict Transport Security headers.

methods.name: after prepare_action
methods.description: Hook that executes after the 'prepare_action' method in Catalyst, setting the HSTS header if conditions are met.
